source_statement: [4] Circles ω1 , ω2 , and ω3 are centered at M, N, and O, respectively. The points of tangency between ω2 and ω3 , ω3 and ω1 , and ω1 and ω2 are tangent at A, B, and C, respectively. Line M O intersects ω3 and ω1 again at P and Q respectively, and line AP intersects ω2 again at R. Given that ABC is an equilateral triangle of side length 1, compute the area of P QR.

clause_ledger.source: three pairwise tangent circles and equilateral ABC of side 1
clause_ledger.dsl: the forced unit-circle/equilateral-center realization M=(0,sqrt(3)), N=(-1,0), O=(1,0), with A,B,C the pairwise contact midpoints

clause_ledger.source: MO meets omega3 and omega1 again at P,Q
clause_ledger.dsl: P and Q are the intersections opposite the contact point B on the center line

clause_ledger.source: AP meets omega2 again at R
